```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(knitr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
# Finished stat-line careers whose last season is in a completed season. The
# final season is read through the box-score absence signal.
complete_through <- last_complete_cfb_season()
game_window <- 2016:complete_through
store <- file.path(root, "_targets")
player_game <- targets::tar_read(player_game, store = store)
usage <- targets::tar_read(player_usage, store = store)
outcomes <- targets::tar_read(outcomes, store = store)
career_end <- career_end_status(
  targets::tar_read(career, store = store),
  outcomes,
  targets::tar_read(picks_nfl, store = store)
)
stat_ids <- unique(outcomes$playerId[outcomes$has_stat_line])
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
games <- dbReadTable(con, "games")
pos_levels <- setdiff(
  harmonized_position_levels(),
  c("Athlete", "Position not recorded")
)
last_position <- roster |>
  mutate(playerId = as.character(playerId)) |>
  group_by(playerId) |>
  slice_max(season, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(playerId, position_group = harmonize_position(position, "roster"))
careers <- career_end |>
  inner_join(last_position, by = "playerId") |>
  filter(position_group %in% pos_levels, last_season <= complete_through) |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, pos_levels))
statline <- careers |>
  filter(career_end != "right_censored", playerId %in% stat_ids)

ending_labels <- c(
  early_stop = "Stopped with eligibility left",
  eligibility_exhausted = "Used up eligibility",
  eligibility_unknown = "Stopped, eligibility unknown",
  transferred_then_stopped = "Changed schools, then stopped",
  signed_udfa = "Signed undrafted",
  drafted = "Drafted"
)
ending_codes <- c(
  "early_stop",
  "eligibility_exhausted",
  "transferred_then_stopped",
  "signed_udfa",
  "drafted"
)

pos_seasons <- usage |>
  filter(on_roster, team_games > 0, season %in% game_window) |>
  group_by(playerId, season) |>
  filter(n() == 1L) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(position_group %in% pos_levels) |>
  select(playerId, season, team, position_group)
absence <- player_appearance_sequence(player_game, roster, games) |>
  filter(season %in% game_window) |>
  absence_runs(
    streak = formals(absence_runs)$streak,
    min_gap = formals(absence_runs)$min_gap
  ) |>
  inner_join(pos_seasons, by = c("playerId", "season", "team"))

final_by_ending <- final_endings(statline, absence, game_window, ending_codes) |>
  mutate(
    ending = factor(ending_labels[career_end], ending_labels[ending_codes]),
    is_claim = career_end %in% c("early_stop", "eligibility_exhausted"),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %s of %s readable final seasons end in an absence",
      ending,
      pct(season_ending),
      fmt(round(careers * readable))
    )
  )

p <- final_by_ending |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = season_ending,
    y = forcats::fct_rev(ending),
    fill = is_claim
  )) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = career_end),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9CA3AF", `TRUE` = "#B45309")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Do early stops end in an absence more than used-up careers?",
    subtitle = "Share of readable final seasons that end in a season-ending absence, by how the career ended",
    x = "Share ending in an absence",
    y = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "final-season-absence-by-ending", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-position-figure
# The same comparison by position, for the two endings the claim sets against
# each other; point size is the number of readable final seasons.
final <- statline |>
  filter(last_season %in% game_window, career_end %in% ending_codes) |>
  left_join(
    select(absence, playerId, season, observable, absence_shape),
    by = c("playerId", "last_season" = "season")
  ) |>
  mutate(observable = observable %in% TRUE)
by_pos_final <- final |>
  filter(observable, career_end %in% c("early_stop", "eligibility_exhausted")) |>
  group_by(position_group, career_end) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    season_ending = mean(absence_shape == "season_ending"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ending = ending_labels[career_end],
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s: %s of %s readable final seasons end in an absence",
      position_group,
      ending,
      pct(season_ending),
      fmt(n)
    )
  )
p_pos <- ggplot(
  by_pos_final,
  aes(season_ending, forcats::fct_rev(position_group), colour = ending)
) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, career_end), size = n),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      `Stopped with eligibility left` = "#B45309",
      `Used up eligibility` = "#1D4ED8"
    )
  ) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 9, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Does the gap between the two endings hold at each position?",
    subtitle = "Point size is the number of readable final seasons",
    x = "Share of readable final seasons ending in a season-ending absence",
    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()
card_interactive(p_pos)
```

```{r}
#| label: ending-table
final_by_ending |>
  transmute(
    Ending = as.character(ending),
    Careers = fmt(careers),
    `Final season can be read` = pct(readable),
    `Final season ends in an absence` = pct(season_ending)
  ) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Ending",
      "Careers",
      "Final season can be read",
      "Final season ends in an absence"
    ),
    align = "lrrr",
    caption = paste0(
      "Finished stat-line careers whose last season is ",
      min(game_window),
      " to ",
      max(game_window),
      ". Careers whose eligibility is unknown are left out. The absence share is among the final seasons that can be read."
    )
  )
```
